name: 燒黑的鐵桶
caption: 二十八尊都還了。它一尊都沒有收。
prompt: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset type: one close-up evidence photograph for a Taiwanese folk-horror game, landscape3:2. Meticulously realistic physical object, tactile worn materials, shallow but sufficient depth of field with key clues all in focus, practical flashlight and muted amber spill, damp abandoned Taiwanese mountain temple in2026, grounded documentary photography. Suspense from concrete evidence rather than monsters. One coherent photograph, not collage or split panels. No captions, no UI, no watermark, no extraneous lettering. Keep important object well exposed and complete in frame. Subject: Top-three-quarter close view inside a soot-black steel burn barrel: burned BAMBOO skeletons of small Taiwanese paper effigies, numerous intact flat painted PAPER FACES resting in ash all oriented toward same shadowy hatch outside frame. Their faces visibly paper craft, NOT real severed heads. A white empty cotton work glove at barrel base has unnaturally long stretched THUMB. Delivery paper with only '二十八尊' readable. No human remains or gore, uncanny mundane materials. CRITICAL ART DIRECTION: This must be a frightening NIGHT-TIME location photograph, NOT a clean studio product shot or daytime illustration. Background falls into deep near-black darkness, only a narrow off-camera FLASHLIGHT beam with faint dying candle spill reveals the evidence. Surroundings ancient, neglected, water-damaged, cracked wood, mold, cobwebs, grime, realistic soot. Low-key cold desaturated green-black shadows, dirty muted amber highlights. Claustrophobic, unsettling horror-film realism, fine believable materials. No sunshine, bright window, white studio backdrop, glossy showroom, excessive fog hiding clues, or comic illustration. Keep clue readable in the flashlight pool; do not underexpose the key object.
